summary: Iteration 2 verified colony-based bulk assign fixes and surveyor map regression. Backend: 3/3 pytest cases pass — /api/admin/areas returns wards+colonies (Kirti Nagar, Didar Nagar, Masita House, Sector 5, Seed Colony, Ward 1, etc.); /api/admin/properties?ward=Kirti%20Nagar returns 3 colony-matched rows; /api/admin/assign-bulk with {area:'Kirti Nagar', employee_ids:[surveyor2]} responds '{message: Assigned Test Surveyor 2 to 3 properties in Kirti Nagar}' and assignment persists. Frontend: admin login → /admin/properties → 'Bulk Assign by Area' dialog opens; Area/Colony dropdown (data-testid=bulk-area-select) lists colonies (Didar Nagar, Kirti Nagar, Masita House, Sector 5, Seed Colony, Ward 1, ZZZ_UnknownColony, plus a few numeric wards). Selecting 'Kirti Nagar' shows '3 properties in this area', selecting Rahul Surveyor and clicking Assign updates all 3 Kirti Nagar rows to 'Rahul Surveyor, Test Surveyor 2'. Area-filter dropdown on the table also lists colonies. Surveyor map regression: logged in as surveyor1, /employee/properties shows 5 pins with mixed colours (2 red pending, 1 yellow submitted, 2 green approved) both immediately and after 25s live refresh — no disappearing markers.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py remains very large; consider modularising admin/properties/areas endpoints.
assign-bulk response only returns a human-readable 'message' string — consider returning structured fields (assigned_count, area, employee_ids) for easier client parsing and testing.
seed_data_creation: None new — reused existing TEST_ properties in Kirti Nagar.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk assign dialog uses shadcn Select. Selectors: [data-testid=bulk-assign-btn] opens dialog, [data-testid=bulk-area-select] is the area combobox, options appear as [role=option] in a portal, [data-testid=confirm-assign-btn] submits. Employee rows are clickable labels (no native input[type=checkbox]). assign-bulk API returns {message: 'Assigned <name> to <n> properties in <area>'}.
rca of the issue: N/A — all previously reported fixes verified working end-to-end.
